# Contracts Checklist: ISK-0008 — Local Developer Environment & Reproducible Compose

**Purpose**: Check that the `local-environment` contract is complete, versioned, owned, and consistent with the spec, and that it changes no earlier contract
**Created**: 2026-11-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Versioning and Ownership

- [x] CHK001 - Does the contract state its version, owning spec, and the review owner of each section? [Completeness, Spec §TR-16, Contract header]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the change procedure defined, including which changes are breaking and how `docs/04`'s link is repointed? [Completeness, Contract §Changing this contract]
- [x] CHK003 - Is ISK-0021's change to the expected smoke state named as a revision, not an edit? [Clarity, Spec §AV-6, Contract §Changing this contract, §Known limits]
- [x] CHK004 - Does every item of TR-16's ownership list have a section in the contract? [Coverage, Spec §TR-16]

## Compatibility With Earlier Contracts

- [x] CHK005 - Is it stated that no rule of the container, persistence, coordination, configuration, or hosting contract changes, and is this measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-021, §SC-009, §SC-010, Research R19]
- [x] CHK006 - Are the settlements of ISK-0003 AV-6 and ISK-0007 AV-6 recorded at a named contract rule, and in `docs/04`? [Traceability, Contract §Services 4, §Documents 4, Tasks T040]
- [x] CHK007 - Does each claim the contract makes about another contract cite the rule it relies on? [Traceability, Contract §Services 4, §Valkey, §Native runs 3, 4, §Exit codes]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the separation from ISK-0007's acceptance fixture stated as a rule that a test can check? [Measurability, Spec §FR-001, Contract §Layout 2, Tasks T012]

## Consistency With the Spec

- [x] CHK009 - Do the contract's services, modes, and profiles match TR-2, including the correction that `dependencies` is a mode, not a profile? [Consistency, Spec §TR-2, Contract §Modes, Research R2]
- [x] CHK010 - Do the contract's exit codes cover every class TR-12 names, including the migration script's pass-through? [Consistency, Spec §TR-12, Contract §Exit codes]
- [x] CHK011 - Do the smoke assertions cover every item of TR-13, with the readiness body stated exactly and the procedure for confirming its bytes in `implement`? [Completeness, Spec §TR-13, Contract §Smoke assertions 3, Tasks T027]
- [x] CHK012 - Is smoke assertion 5's "exactly the roles" unambiguous about the superuser and PostgreSQL's predefined roles? [Ambiguity, Contract §Smoke assertions 5]
  - Settled in `checklist`: the contract said "exactly the roles and grants of PostgreSQL rule 1", while T030 also allowed `postgres` and `pg_*`. The contract and R13 now name both exceptions.
- [x] CHK013 - Is smoke's result in the `dependencies` mode defined, since the spec's US2 independent test names that mode? [Coverage, Spec §US2, Contract §Smoke assertions]
  - Settled in `checklist`: the contract said only "against the running default topology". It now states that in the `dependencies` mode assertion 1 fails and smoke exits 1.
- [x] CHK014 - Is the output channel of `--help` consistent between the contract and the tasks? [Consistency, Contract §Scripts, Tasks T019]
  - Settled in `checklist`: the contract said every message goes to standard error, while T019 printed usage to standard output. The contract now says usage goes to standard output and messages to standard error, and T021 asserts it.
- [x] CHK015 - Do the contract's bounds (180 s start, 60 s lifecycle wait, 15 s probe) agree with research and are they marked as safety bounds, not performance figures? [Consistency, Spec §TR-11, Plan §Technical Context, Research R12]

## Test Fixtures

- [x] CHK016 - Are the acceptance test's clean-copy rule, project-name pattern, cleanup, and cycle count stated, and do they match SC-001 and FR-022? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001, §FR-022, Contract §Test fixtures]
- [x] CHK017 - Is the container-runtime skip-or-fail rule extended to `bash` and `git`, with the same CI behavior? [Completeness, Contract §Test fixtures 3, Tasks T009]
- [x] CHK018 - Do tests that run native hosts use free ports, as the fixture rule requires of every test? [Consistency, Contract §Test fixtures 2, Tasks T037]
  - Settled in `checklist`: T037 ran native hosts on the native documents' fixed listener ports, and failed when one was in use. The contract's Test fixtures rule 2, R17, and T037 now give a test's native host free listener ports in its temporary copy of the native documents.
- [x] CHK019 - Is each exit code of the contract assigned to at least one test? [Coverage, Spec §SC-008, Research R17, Tasks T039]
